correctness.rationale: An undominated cell is exactly the intersection of an empty row and an empty column. With m≤n the optimal size is m; optimizers are row transversals, together with column transversals exactly when m=n. The all-positive trace forces a support into one such transversal family, and each negative request in that family can be met by using a different cell in its queried row (or column), since m,n≥2. This proves both trace criteria. Counting the two families and their partial-permutation overlap gives the polynomials and VC dimension; extending within a family proves purity. The displayed row/column basis exchange fails for n≥3 because deleting (2,1) from column 1 still leaves (1,1) and another cell in column 1. The rectangular join is a wedge of (n−1)^m spheres of dimension m−1 by the suspension-smash description of joins. In the square case the intersection of the row and column joins is the chessboard complex; their homology vanishes below n−1, giving exactly the claimed reduced Mayer–Vietoris range. Jonsson's Theorem 3.1 supplies integral H2(M5,5)=Z/3 and Theorems 1.1 and 3 verify the degree bounds. The reduced Euler characteristic is 2104 and the top kernel is free. Jonsson's Theorem 2 applies at d=n−4 since (2n−4)/3≤n−4 precisely for n≥8, so the shift supplies the asserted lower-dimensional torsion and rules out pure shellability. A fresh direct closed-neighborhood/trace test exhausts 2×2, 2×3 and 3×3, and the size-five vector and Euler arithmetic were independently checked.
residual_risks: No general torsion computation is inferred from sampled boards or modular ranks. The all-order proof depends on the stated integral chessboard theorems. The shift is not asserted in top degree.

value.rationale: The rectangular-to-square change in the optimizer families changes the topology of an intrinsically defined learning complex. It produces a natural, exactly described family of pure nonshellable shattering complexes with integral torsion and a simple rectangular control case. This is more than recomputing the known square optimizer count or rediscovering chessboard torsion on the original chessboard object.
residual_risks: The shift does not resolve the full homotopy type or give an equivariant or general graph-family classification.
